verdict.rationale: Fellow records and transcribes calls, so clipping a moment from a recording is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no clip, soundbite, or moment-sharing feature, though. The 'highlights' in Fellow Markdown are a note-content formatting element, and timestamped transcripts are only a building block, so neither counts toward cutting and sharing a portion of a recording.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
